section: Iterate — change: Inbox in the Triage look
title: Inbox entries as compact Triage rows + detail dialog
context: The Inbox showed tall chat-like cards while Triage shows compact rows; reminders (W3) need one row design next to awaiting-reply entries.
decision: Replace the four card variants with one InboxRow (Triage row CSS, hover/focus action zone) and one light InboxDetailDialog; add a filter bar; reuse TriageIdCopy.
consequences: Client-only. A lead question's answer form now lives in the dialog (one extra click); whole-row click opens the dialog, Open task is explicit.
rationale: Brief rev 2 + approved mockups 01/02 make the dialog the home of full text and actions; a compact row has no room for an inline form.
rejected: Re-skin the cards shorter (cannot match mockup); make TriageItemRow generic (couples two pages with different actions); do nothing.
